findings.overview:
Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that runs in the terminal, IDE, desktop app, and cloud. Architecturally it is "model + agentic harness": the model reasons, while the harness supplies tools, manages the context window, and provides the execution environment. The documented behavior is a deliberately simple ReAct-style loop: gather context, take action, verify results, repeat. The model decides when to stop by returning a response with no tool calls.

The public repo anthropics/claude-code is not the implementation source; it is the product/community repo (README, changelog, plugin marketplace, built-in "mods" plugin sources, examples, issue templates). The programmable form of the same loop is the Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript and Python packages that bundle the native Claude Code binary), documented at code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/agent-loop.md. The Python SDK source shows the transport: it spawns `claude --output-format stream-json --verbose`, exchanges newline-delimited JSON frames, parses assistant/user/system/result messages, and handles control requests (permissions, hooks, MCP, interrupt) over stdin/stdout. Stack: TypeScript/Node CLI and repo tooling; Python SDK wrapper (src/claude_agent_sdk); MCP-style tool results; JSONL session transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/.
findings.coreMechanisms:
Conceptual model (how-claude-code-works.md): the "agentic loop" has three blended phases — gather context, take action, verify results. The model reasons; the "agentic harness" provides tools, manages the context window, and supplies the execution environment. Claude Code is the layer around the model, not a state machine.

Concrete SDK loop (agent-sdk/agent-loop.md): (1) receive the prompt plus system prompt, tool definitions, and conversation history; yield a SystemMessage with subtype "init" carrying session metadata. (2) The model evaluates and responds with text, one or more tool calls, or both; each content block is yielded as its own AssistantMessage. (3) The SDK executes each requested tool and collects results; each set of tool results is fed back to the model as a UserMessage. (4) Steps 2-3 repeat until the model produces a response with no tool calls. (5) The SDK yields a final text-only AssistantMessage, then a ResultMessage with final text, token usage, cost, and session ID. The docs' four-turn example is Bash(npm test) -> Read(auth.ts, auth.test.ts) -> Edit(auth.ts)+Bash(npm test) -> final text.

A turn is one pass through the loop; tool calls inside a turn execute without yielding control back to the caller. max_turns counts turns that contain tool calls plus one final text-only turn, so max_turns=2 in that example stops before the edit step. Hitting the cap produces ResultMessage subtype error_max_turns with no result text; max_budget_usd produces error_max_budget_usd. Without limits the loop runs until the model finishes on its own.

Message construction: SystemMessage (subtypes init, compact_boundary, informational, worker_shutting_down), AssistantMessage (one content block each; blocks from one response share a message ID), UserMessage (tool results plus any mid-loop user input), StreamEvent (raw API deltas when partial messages are enabled), ResultMessage (terminal). Result subtypes: success, error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd, error_during_execution, error_max_structured_output_retries. stop_reason is end_turn, max_tokens, or refusal. In TypeScript, AssistantMessage/UserMessage wrap the raw API message in .message, so content is at message.message.content; in Python, check with isinstance() against classes from claude_agent_sdk.

Prompt structure: the SDK offers three starting points — the full "claude_code" preset (tool guidance plus security/safety instructions), a minimal default that covers tool calling only, or a custom string; append layers extra text after the preset. CLAUDE.md is not part of the system prompt: it is injected into the conversation as project context and introduced by a line telling the model its instructions override default behavior. Dynamic context arrives as "system reminders" in the conversation, wrapped in <\system-reminder> tags (or a separate system-role message on some models), not in the system prompt. Docs recommend a custom prompt include: "The application adds system reminders to this conversation. Treat them as context from the application, not as messages from the user." The repo's .claude/commands/*.md show the prompt-file pattern: YAML frontmatter with allowed-tools and description, inline shell context via !`git status`, then task instructions. commit-push-pr.md explicitly tells the model it can call multiple tools in one response and must do all steps in a single message.

Wire/transport: the Python SDK spawns `claude --output-format stream-json --verbose` (plus `--input-format stream-json` for streaming input) and exchanges newline-delimited JSON. message_parser.py dispatches on message type user/assistant/system/result/stream_event/rate_limit_event/conversation_reset; unknown types are logged and skipped for forward compatibility. The read loop in query.py routes control_response/control_request/control_cancel_request frames and yields normal messages to the consumer; a result frame marks the end of a turn, not necessarily the whole run. Control requests cover can_use_tool permissions, hook callbacks, MCP messages, interrupt, set_permission_mode, MCP status, and context usage.
findings.toolUse:
A tool has four parts: a unique name, a description the model reads to decide when to call it, an input schema (JSON Schema; Zod in TypeScript, dict/Annotated or full JSON Schema in Python), and an async handler. The handler returns an object with content (required array of blocks: text, image, audio, resource, resource_link), optional structuredContent (machine-readable JSON), and optional isError. Handler exceptions do not stop the loop: the in-process MCP server converts an uncaught exception into an error result carrying the raw exception message, and the model can retry or choose another tool. Returning isError:true (TS) / "is_error": True (Python) lets you compose a better message ("API error: 429 ... Failed to fetch ..."), which is what the model reads.

Serialization: a tool call is an assistant content block {"type":"tool_use","id":str,"name":str,"input":{...}}; a result is a user content block {"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":str,"content":...,"is_error":bool}. The Python dataclasses are exactly ToolUseBlock(id, name, input) and ToolResultBlock(tool_use_id, content=None, is_error=None). The id/tool_use_id pair is the correlation key; the SDK yields one AssistantMessage per content block, and tool results return as UserMessage. message_parser.py shows the full wire frame: assistant messages carry message.content, message.model, message.usage, message.stop_reason; user messages may carry tool_use_result and parent_tool_use_id.

Multiple calls in one turn: read-only tools (Read, Glob, Grep, MCP tools marked read-only) can run concurrently; state-modifying tools (Edit, Write, Bash) run sequentially to avoid conflicts. Custom tools default to sequential unless readOnlyHint:true is set in their annotations. Tool definitions themselves consume context; ToolSearch defers MCP and other tool schemas by default, exposing only names until a tool is loaded.

Loop control: the model stops calling tools and the loop ends. Explicit caps max_turns and max_budget_usd produce terminal ResultMessage error subtypes. Permissions short-circuit calls: allowed_tools pre-approves, disallowed_tools blocks, and permission_mode (default, acceptEdits, plan, dontAsk, auto, bypassPermissions) decides whether a call prompts. A denied call is delivered to the model as a rejection tool result, and it typically tries a different approach or reports it could not proceed.

Host permission protocol (Python SDK query.py): the CLI emits a control_request with subtype "can_use_tool" carrying tool_name, input, tool_use_id, permission_suggestions, blocked_path, decision_reason, title, display_name, description. The host calls can_use_tool(tool_name, input_data, context) and replies {"behavior":"allow","updatedInput":...} or {"behavior":"deny","message":...,"interrupt":...}. PermissionResultAllow can rewrite the input (e.g., redirect a write path); PermissionResultDeny can end the turn. This is a clean pattern for a GUI approval dialog: the agent subprocess asks the host, and the host answers, rather than the model prompting in text.

Built-in tool semantics from tools-reference.md: Read expects absolute paths and returns line-numbered text, at most 25,000 tokens per call and refusing a whole file over 256 KB (a PARTIAL view notice otherwise). Edit is exact string replacement: old_string must appear exactly as written and exactly once; use replace_all to replace every occurrence; read-before-edit is enforced. Write creates or overwrites the whole file. Bash runs each command in a separate process with a default 2-minute timeout (BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) and a 10-minute ceiling (BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS); valid output is inline up to roughly 30,000 characters, then the result becomes a file path plus a 2,000-character preview; failures are inline up to roughly 10,000 characters as a head-and-tail excerpt. Glob caps at 100 files sorted by modification time; Grep uses ripgrep regex with files_with_matches, content, and count modes. For DeepSeek's OpenAI-compatible API the same design maps to tools:[{type:"function",function:{name,description,parameters:JSON Schema}}], assistant.tool_calls[] with id/function.name/function.arguments (a JSON string), and role:"tool" messages carrying tool_call_id and content.
findings.contextManagement:
Context contains the system prompt, tool definitions, conversation history, tool inputs/outputs, CLAUDE.md, auto memory, and loaded skills; it does not reset between turns. Stable content (system prompt, tool definitions, CLAUDE.md) is prompt-cached automatically; CLAUDE.md is re-injected on every request. Auto memory loads the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md, whichever comes first. Tool definitions can dominate context, which is why ToolSearch defers schemas.

Compaction: when the window approaches its limit, the SDK/CLI summarizes older history, keeping recent exchanges and key decisions, and emits a SystemMessage with subtype compact_boundary. It can be guided by a "Compact Instructions" or "Summary instructions" section in CLAUDE.md (free-form header; the compactor matches intent), by a PreCompact hook (trigger manual or auto), or by /compact with a focus such as "/compact focus on the API changes". The changelog notes that when the model's reply contains no summary, Claude Code usually asks for the summary once more before replacing the conversation.

What survives compaction (context-window.md): system prompt and output style still apply; project-root CLAUDE.md and unscoped rules are re-injected from disk; auto memory is re-injected; skill descriptions are rebuilt; git status is refreshed; the plan is re-injected from disk; path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md reload on demand. Claude Code re-reads up to five files that were read or edited, most recently modified first; a file over 5,000 tokens comes back as a path reference rather than its content. Invoked skill bodies are re-injected capped at 5,000 tokens per skill and 25,000 tokens total, oldest dropped first. Background commands and subagents keep running and the model is reminded of them.

Threshold behavior: the auto-compaction point is model-dependent. For an unrecognized model ID, such as a custom gateway alias, the changelog says Claude Code assumes a 200K context window; for a custom model like deepseek-v4-pro the window should be configured explicitly rather than relying on that default. A model switch or fallback from 1M to 200K can also trigger the thrashing error.

Thrashing circuit breaker: if compaction succeeds but a single file or tool output immediately refills the window several times in a row, Claude Code stops retrying to avoid wasting API calls and shows "Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit...". Recovery advice is to read the oversized file in chunks, /compact with a focus that drops the large output, move large reads to a subagent, or /clear. Context-saving devices: subagents run in their own context window and return only a summary; Bash output beyond ~30,000 characters is externalized to a file with a preview; Read truncates at 25,000 tokens / 256 KB; large images are resized and recompressed.

Prompt-caching nuance: dynamic per-user sections (auto memory path, working directory, platform, shell, OS) are delivered in the conversation rather than the system prompt so they do not break cache reuse; excludeDynamicSections moves the per-user context into the first user message, leaving only the static preset plus append text in the system prompt so identical configurations share a cache entry.
findings.errorHandling:
Automatic retries (errors.md): Claude Code retries transient failures up to 10 times with exponential backoff before showing an error (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES default 10, capped at 15; changelog v2.1.286 changed this so one limit covers a whole model call, sending at most 14 requests for a failing call). Retried: 5xx/overloaded/timeouts that arrive before any response has streamed; a server error after thinking but before any text or tool call (up to 2 retries); dropped connections; stalled response streams (one re-stream); temporary 429 throttles (not a gateway spend-limit 429); context-overflow 400s, by retrying with reduced max_tokens, then compacting; and a response that claims a tool call but contains none (ask again up to twice, final error "The model's tool call could not be parsed (retry also failed)."). Not retried: TLS certificate validation failures; failures after a text block or tool call has completed or started, because re-running could execute the same tool calls twice — Claude Code keeps the completed output, runs finished tool calls, and continues the turn; organization policy denials; gateway spend-limit 429s. For 529 overloads, backoff base is 500 ms and ceiling 32,000 ms; API_TIMEOUT_MS defaults to 600,000 ms for response headers.

Tool-level errors: handler exceptions become error tool results and the loop continues; the model can retry the tool, try another, or explain the failure. A permission denial arrives as a rejection tool result, not a crash. PreToolUse hooks can block a call before execution; the repo's examples/hooks/bash_command_validator_example.py reads JSON {tool_name, tool_input} from stdin and uses exit code 2 to block the tool call and show stderr to the model, exit 1 to show stderr only to the user, and exit 0 to allow. PostToolUse and Stop hooks provide audit and validation; a Stop hook can return additionalContext to keep the turn going. The repo's own CLAUDE.md hardens CI: egress-firewall runner, network allow-list, --permission-mode auto, minimal permissions, and --disallowedTools. examples/settings/settings-strict.json disables bypass-permissions mode, asks for every Bash call, denies WebSearch/WebFetch, allows managed hooks only, and configures sandbox network restrictions.

Stopping conditions: (a) a model response with no tool calls is natural completion; (b) max_turns yields ResultMessage error_max_turns; (c) max_budget_usd yields error_max_budget_usd — spend is checked after responses arrive, so it can overshoot by one response plus running subagents; (d) error_during_execution means a crash or cancellation; (e) error_max_structured_output_retries means no valid structured output within the retry limit; (f) stop_reason of refusal or max_tokens. ResultMessage always carries total_cost_usd, usage, num_turns, session_id, and stop_reason. A single-shot query() yields the error result and then raises; a streaming session stays alive and can continue.

Runaway prevention: WebSearch is capped at 200 calls per session (configurable and refillable), subagent spawns at 200 per session, background commands have time limits, auto-compaction has a thrashing breaker, and permission modes plus sandboxing limit what can execute. File edits are checkpointed (snapshotted before edit) and can be rewound. For an auto-repair loop, the analogous pattern is a hard attempt cap per check plus a circuit breaker that reports the failure instead of retrying forever.
keyImplementationDetails: Loop termination is model-driven: the loop runs until a response contains no tool calls; the final ResultMessage subtype is success and only that subtype carries result text. max_turns counts tool-call turns plus one final text-only turn; too low a cap ends with error_max_turns before the last action.

Wire format: assistant tool call = {"type":"tool_use","id":str,"name":str,"input":{...}}; tool result = {"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":str,"content":...,"is_error":bool}, returned inside a user message. The tool_use id is the correlation key.
Python SDK dataclasses: ToolUseBlock(id: str, name: str, input: dict[str, Any]); ToolResultBlock(tool_use_id: str, content: str | list[dict] | None = None, is_error: bool | None = None).

Tool definition = name + description + input schema (JSON Schema) + async handler; handler returns {"content":[...], "structuredContent"?: {...}, "isError"?: bool}. isError lets the host compose the message the model sees instead of exposing a raw exception.
Read-only tools can execute concurrently; Edit/Write/Bash execute sequentially; custom tools are sequential unless annotations.readOnlyHint is true.

Permission modes are default, acceptEdits, plan, dontAsk, auto, bypassPermissions. allowed_tools pre-approves, disallowed_tools blocks; a denied call is returned as a rejection tool result and the model adapts.

can_use_tool(tool_name, input_data, context) returns PermissionResultAllow(updated_input=...) or PermissionResultDeny(message=..., interrupt=...); the SDK serializes this to {"behavior":"allow","updatedInput":...} or {"behavior":"deny","message":...}.

PreToolUse hook contract: JSON on stdin with tool_name and tool_input; exit 2 blocks the call and sends stderr to the model; exit 1 sends stderr to the user only; exit 0 allows. This is implemented in examples/hooks/bash_command_validator_example.py.

Read tool: absolute paths, line-numbered output, max 25,000 tokens per call, refuses a whole file over 256 KB, and returns a PARTIAL view notice when truncated; offset/limit page through larger files.

Edit tool: exact old_string -> new_string replacement, old_string must appear exactly once (or replace_all:true), no regex or fuzzy matching; read-before-edit is enforced, including a write to an existing unread file on older models.

Bash tool: separate process per command; BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 120,000 ms, BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS = 600,000 ms; valid output inline up to ~30,000 chars then a file path plus 2,000-char preview; failures inline up to ~10,000 chars as head-and-tail excerpt.

Compaction keeps recent exchanges and key decisions, emits a compact_boundary SystemMessage, then re-reads up to five recently modified files and re-injects CLAUDE.md/auto memory/plan; files over 5,000 tokens come back as path references; skill bodies are capped at 5,000 tokens each and 25,000 total.

Retry defaults: up to 10 attempts with exponential backoff (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES, hard cap 15); a failing model call sends at most 14 requests (changelog v2.1.286). A tool-call-unparseable response is retried up to twice, then the turn ends with "The model's tool call could not be parsed (retry also failed)."

Claude Code does not retry a failure that arrives after a text block or tool call has completed or started, because it could execute the same tool calls twice; it keeps the completed output and continues. 529 overload backoff starts at 500 ms and caps at 32,000 ms; API_TIMEOUT_MS defaults to 600,000 ms.

Transport/flags: the Python SDK launches `claude --output-format stream-json --verbose`, adds `--input-format stream-json`, `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools`, `--permission-mode`, `--append-system-prompt`, and exchanges newline-delimited JSON frames; unknown message types are skipped, not fatal.
lessonsForOurAgent: Keep the core loop minimal and stateless: messages = [system, user]; while turn < max_turns: call the model; if no tool calls, stop; otherwise append the assistant message (with tool_calls) and one result message per call, then repeat. Claude Code's documented loop is exactly this; the complexity lives in tools, context budgeting, and permissions, not in a state machine.

Use DeepSeek's OpenAI-compatible tool protocol directly: tools=[{type:'function',function:{name,description,parameters}}], assistant.tool_calls[] with id/function.name/function.arguments, and role:'tool' messages with the matching tool_call_id. Never batch all results into one text blob when real tool-call IDs are available.

Define a small, precise tool set: read_file(path, offset, limit), write_file(path, content), edit_file(path, old_string, new_string, replace_all), list_files(pattern), run_check(command, timeout), and finish(summary, status). Write strict JSON Schemas and detailed descriptions; the description is part of the prompt and drives correct tool choice.

Return failures as tool results, not exceptions into the GUI: serializable output with status/error/message, plus actionable hints (what failed, which path, what to try). This mirrors isError and lets the model recover without crashing the Tkinter app.

Separate read-only from mutating tools. Read-only calls (list/read/check) can run concurrently; write/edit/run must be serialized. Enforce read-before-edit and exact-match edits to avoid corrupting generated files.

Manage context explicitly. Send the preprocessed architecture JSON and system prompt once, keep a compact project manifest (files, status, open errors) instead of re-sending generated file contents, and truncate tool output (e.g., 20k-30k chars) with the full text saved to a log file and only a path plus preview returned.

Implement compaction before the model's limit, not at it: at a configurable fraction (e.g., 60-70%) of the context window, summarize older turns with a fixed schema (objective and acceptance criteria, files read/modified, test results and error messages, decisions and reasoning) and re-inject the architecture JSON, plan, manifest, and current failures. Claude Code's compaction preserves exactly these categories.

Make the model context window a GUI setting. Claude Code assumes 200K for unrecognized model IDs; DeepSeek's real window for deepseek-v4-pro may differ, and a wrong assumption either truncates early or overflows. Also expose base_url, model name, max_tokens, temperature, and API key as fields.

Batch file generation rather than one LLM call per file. Have the model emit a plan/manifest, group small files into batches, write each batch through the write_file tool, and show progress in the GUI. Fewer calls means less latency, less cost, and fewer partial-failure states.

Cap everything: max_turns, max API calls or budget, max tool calls per turn, and max auto-repair rounds. For repair, run only cheap checks (py_compile syntax, JSON validity, required files present), allow at most 2-3 rounds per issue, and on exhaustion stop and output the result annotated as unverified rather than looping.

Retry only transient API failures (429/5xx/timeouts) with exponential backoff and a small cap (3-5 attempts for a desktop app is reasonable), and never re-run a request after tool calls have already executed. Surface authentication/model errors immediately instead of retrying.

Add a permission layer with a path jail under the output directory, a command denylist/allowlist, and a PreToolUse-style validator that returns a block reason before execution. For destructive operations, ask via the GUI (allow/deny, optionally rewrite the input path), mirroring PermissionResultAllow.updated_input and PermissionResultDeny.message.

Persist a JSONL transcript of every message and tool result, and snapshot files before overwriting them. This gives resume/debug/undo and makes the mock-LLM versus real-LLM switch transparent. Run the agent loop in a worker thread and marshal progress to Tkinter through a queue so the UI stays responsive.

findings.availability: WebFetch was blocked for this domain ("Unable to verify if domain api-docs.deepseek.com is safe to fetch"), so I fetched it directly with curl. Every page listed above was retrieved successfully at its `.md` variant (the site serves clean Markdown for each doc URL). This target is official documentation, not a code repository, so there was no README, file tree, or source to inspect; the tool-calling agent loop comes from the docs' Tool Calls and Thinking Mode guides. I also made one live unauthenticated probe: GET https://api.deepseek.com/models returns HTTP 401 with the plain-text body `Authentication Fails (governor)` and an `x-ds-trace-id` header. No request was made with the user's API key.
findings.overview: This is DeepSeek's official API documentation site, a static Docusaurus documentation site whose pages are also served as clean Markdown by appending `.md` to the path. It documents a stateless HTTP/JSON API that is wire-compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions (and separately with Anthropic Messages), so our Python agent can call it with plain `requests` and no SDK. The API has no conversation/session resource: state lives entirely on the client, and every turn must resend the full `messages` array. The model id enum is exactly `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`; the user's requested `deepseek-v4-pro` is confirmed as a current, real model (served by DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813), not a typo. The docs contain no agent implementation source and no prescribed agent system prompt, but the Tool Calls guide and the Thinking Mode guide together give a complete canonical tool-calling loop that maps directly onto our planned agent.
findings.coreMechanisms:
Wire contract: `POST https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions` with `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` and `Content-Type: application/json`; `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models` lists models and capabilities. An Anthropic-format surface lives at `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic`, and beta features (strict tool schemas, prefix completion) at `https://api.deepseek.com/beta`. `model` and `messages` are the only required body fields. Message roles are `system`, `user`, `assistant`, and `tool`; assistant messages may carry `content` (nullable), `reasoning_content`, and `tool_calls`; tool messages require `role`, `content`, and `tool_call_id`. Optional controls: `thinking`, `reasoning_effort`, `max_tokens`, `response_format`, `stop` (up to 16 sequences), `stream`, `stream_options`, `temperature` (0-2, default 1), `top_p`, `tools`, `tool_choice`, and `user_id`.

Models: the enum is exactly `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`. `deepseek-v4-pro` is DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, text-only, 1M-token context (1,048,576), maximum output 384K tokens (393,216), account concurrency 500; `deepseek-flash` is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, supports image input, concurrency 2,500. Both default to thinking mode at `high` effort. For v4-pro, per-1M-token pricing is $0.022/$0.044 cache-hit input, $0.66/$1.32 cache-miss input, and $1.98/$3.96 output (off-peak/peak).

Response: `{id, object:"chat.completion", created, model, system_fingerprint, choices:[{index, finish_reason, message}], usage}`. `finish_reason` is one of `stop`, `length`, `content_filter`, `tool_calls`, `insufficient_system_resource`, `aborted`. `usage` contains `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`, `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`, `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`, `prompt_cache_miss_tokens`, and optionally `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`.

Agent loop (from the Tool Calls and Thinking Mode guides): call the model with `tools`; append `response.choices[0].message` to `messages`; if `tool_calls` is null, stop; otherwise run each local function with `json.loads(call.function.arguments)` and append `{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":call.id,"content":<result>}` for each call; call again. The model never executes functions itself. Streaming uses SSE: `data: {...}` chunks plus a final `data: [DONE]`; `delta.content`, `delta.reasoning_content`, and `delta.tool_calls` arrive incrementally, with tool-call fragments keyed by `index`.
findings.toolUse:
Tools are declared as `tools: [{"type":"function","function":{"name":"write_file","description":"...","parameters":{<JSON Schema>},"strict":false}}]`; function names are at most 128 chars of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_`, `-`, and must be unique. The model replies with `message.tool_calls`, an array of `{id, type:"function", function:{name, arguments}}`, where `arguments` is a JSON-encoded string. The docs explicitly warn that the model does not always generate valid JSON and may hallucinate parameters, so arguments must be parsed and validated before execution. Multiple tool calls can appear in one assistant turn.

To feed results back: append the assistant message exactly as received (including `reasoning_content` when thinking mode is on), execute each function, then append one `{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":<id>,"content":<string>}` message per call, and call the model again. The loop ends when `tool_calls` is null/empty, normally with `finish_reason:"stop"`. `tool_choice` accepts `none`, `auto`, `required`, or `{"type":"function","function":{"name":"..."}}`; `required` and named choices return HTTP 400 in thinking mode. In streaming mode, the first tool-call fragment carries `id`, `type`, and `function.name`; later fragments carry only argument text, all keyed by `index`, so fragments must be assembled before execution. Beta `strict:true` mode (base_url `/beta`) enforces the schema: every object property must be in `required` and every object must set `additionalProperties:false`; supported constructs are object, string, number, integer, boolean, array, enum, anyOf, plus `$def`/`$ref`. Chat Completions cannot have tool calls inserted mid-conversation; the Anthropic and Responses APIs can.
findings.contextManagement:
Context is entirely client-managed because the API is stateless: each request resends the full `messages` history, so context grows linearly with loop iterations. The context window is 1,048,576 tokens for both models, shared by input and output. `max_tokens` caps generated output: default 8K in non-thinking mode, 64K in thinking mode, 128K with `reasoning_effort:"max"`; accepted range is 1..393,216. The system prompt is a leading `system` message; Chat Completions also permits inserting `system` messages mid-conversation, but does not permit inserting tool calls mid-conversation.

In thinking mode with `tools`, `reasoning_content` from all previous turns must be sent back and is concatenated into context; without `tools` it is ignored. Prompt caching is automatic and reported per request via `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`, `prompt_cache_miss_tokens`, and `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`; a stable system-prompt prefix maximizes hits. There is no server-side summarization or compaction API, so trimming/summarizing is the client's job. DeepSeek's own Claude Code integration sets `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=786432` (75% of the 1M window) and `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max`, a concrete hint at a practical compaction budget. The docs prescribe no agent system prompt; the only prompt text given is the JSON-mode example, which must contain the word "json" and a sample of the desired JSON structure.
findings.errorHandling:
HTTP errors: 400 invalid request-body format, 401 authentication failure, 402 insufficient balance, 422 invalid parameters, 429 rate/concurrency limit, 500 server error, 503 server overloaded. Rate limiting is documented as account-level concurrency (500 for deepseek-v4-pro, 2,500 for deepseek-flash); exceeding it returns 429, and no per-minute request or token quotas are published. Retry 429/500/503 with backoff; fix the request for 400/422; check the key for 401; surface 402 to the user. Error bodies are not guaranteed to be JSON: a live unauthenticated `GET /models` returned HTTP 401 with the plain-text body `Authentication Fails (governor)` plus an `x-ds-trace-id` header, so error parsing must be defensive.

Generation-level failures appear in `finish_reason`: `length` means truncation (raise max_tokens or split work), `content_filter` means filtered output, `insufficient_system_resource` means an inference-resource interruption (retry), and `aborted` means generation was interrupted. JSON Output can return `content` containing only spaces with `finish_reason:"stop"` when the model fails to emit JSON, so validate and retry. Tool arguments may be invalid JSON and must be validated. In thinking+tools mode, omitting prior `reasoning_content` returns 400; `tool_choice:"required"` or a named tool also returns 400. `stream_options` without `stream:true` returns 400. If the server has not started inference after 10 minutes it closes the connection; non-streaming keep-alive appears as blank lines and streaming keep-alive as `: keep-alive` SSE comments.
keyImplementationDetails: Base URL is `https://api.deepseek.com`; the chat endpoint is `POST /chat/completions`; auth is `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`; model discovery is `GET /models`; beta base URL is `https://api.deepseek.com/beta`.

The model enum is exactly `["deepseek-flash","deepseek-v4-pro"]`. `GET /models` reports `deepseek-v4-pro` as DeepSeek-V4-Pro with `context_window:1048576`, `max_output_tokens:393216`, `input_modalities:["text"]`, and effort levels low/high/max with default high.

`deepseek-v4-pro` is DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813: 1M context, max output 384K (393216), concurrency 500 per account, no vision. Pricing per 1M tokens is cache hit $0.022/$0.044, cache miss $0.66/$1.32, output $1.98/$3.96 (off-peak/peak).

Request body requires `model` and `messages` (minItems 1). Optional fields: `thinking`, `reasoning_effort`, `max_tokens`, `response_format`, `stop` (up to 16), `stream`, `stream_options`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `tools`, `tool_choice`, `user_id`.
`max_tokens` accepts 1..393216. When omitted the default is 8K in non-thinking mode, 64K in thinking mode, and 128K when `reasoning_effort` is `max`.

`temperature` ranges 0-2 with default 1 and has no effect in thinking mode. `frequency_penalty` and `presence_penalty` are deprecated and ignored. For v4-pro, `top_p` is ignored in thinking mode (fixed 0.95 when tool calling is enabled, otherwise 1.0) but takes effect in non-thinking mode.

Thinking mode is enabled by default at `high` effort. Toggle with top-level `"thinking":{"type":"enabled"|"disabled"}`; `reasoning_effort` accepts none/low/high/max (minimal maps to low, medium and xhigh map to high, ultra maps to max).

With `tools` present in thinking mode, every previous assistant turn's `reasoning_content` must be passed back, or the API returns HTTP 400. Without `tools`, `reasoning_content` is ignored and not concatenated into context.

A tool call arrives as `message.tool_calls[] = {id, type:"function", function:{name, arguments}}` where `arguments` is a JSON-encoded string that may be invalid or contain hallucinated parameters; parse and validate before executing.

Canonical loop: append the assistant message verbatim; if `tool_calls` is null/empty, break; execute each call; append `{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":<id>,"content":<string result>}`; call the model again. The server never executes functions.

Streaming is SSE with `data: {...}` chunks and a final `data: [DONE]`; tool-call fragments are keyed by `index`, the first fragment carries id/type/name and later fragments carry argument fragments. The last chunk before `[DONE]` carries `usage`; `stream_options.include_usage` only controls whether earlier chunks include a null `usage`.

JSON Output requires `response_format:{"type":"json_object"}` AND the word "json" plus an example in the prompt, and a `max_tokens` large enough to avoid truncation. If output is not valid JSON, the API replaces non-JSON content with spaces (U+0020), so `content` can be blank even with `finish_reason:"stop"`; retry in that case.

Response object: `{id, object:"chat.completion", created, model, system_fingerprint, choices:[{index, finish_reason, message:{role, content, reasoning_content?, tool_calls?}}], usage}`. `finish_reason` is stop|length|content_filter|tool_calls|insufficient_system_resource|aborted.

Usage fields: `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`, `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`, `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`, `prompt_cache_miss_tokens`, optional `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`. No separate usage-only streaming chunk is emitted.

Errors: 400 invalid format, 401 auth, 402 balance, 422 invalid params, 429 rate/concurrency, 500 server, 503 overloaded. An observed 401 body is plain text, not JSON; responses carry `x-ds-trace-id`. Non-streaming keep-alive is blank lines, streaming keep-alive is `: keep-alive`; inference not started within 10 minutes causes the server to close the connection.
lessonsForOurAgent: Call `https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions` directly with `requests` and `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; no OpenAI SDK is required, which keeps PyInstaller packaging to one pure-Python dependency. Make base_url, model, and key GUI-configurable and validate them at startup with `GET /models`.

Default the model to `deepseek-v4-pro`: the docs confirm it as a current model id. The earlier assumption that `deepseek-chat` is the only valid name is outdated for this API; the documented enum is only `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`, so fall back to `deepseek-flash` (not `deepseek-chat`) if a gateway rejects v4-pro.

For deterministic project generation, explicitly send `"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}` so `temperature:0` actually takes effect. Thinking mode is on by default and ignores temperature; alternatively keep thinking on for planning but accept nondeterminism.
If thinking stays enabled, append each raw assistant message dict back verbatim, including `reasoning_content` and `tool_calls`. With `tools` present, dropping `reasoning_content` yields HTTP 400.

Implement the documented tool loop with an additional hard cap on model calls (for example 25-40) and treat `finish_reason:"length"` as a failed/truncated turn to retry with larger `max_tokens` or split work, never as completion.

Define a narrow tool set (read_file, write_file, make_dir, list_dir, run_check) with explicit JSON Schemas and string-only results. Wrap every tool execution in try/except and return the exception text as the tool message so the model can self-repair instead of crashing the loop.

Never execute `function.arguments` without `json.loads` in a try/except; on parse or schema failure, append a `tool` message explaining the error. This is the cheapest auto-repair and maps naturally onto the planned 2-3 round repair limit.

Do not regex-parse tool calls out of `content`; use native `tools`/`tool_calls`. For the step that converts the two markdown architecture docs into structured JSON, use `response_format:{"type":"json_object"}` with the word "json" and an example in the prompt, and retry when `content` is blank or spaces-only.

Prefer non-streaming for the generation loop for simplicity; if streaming is used for Tkinter progress, accumulate `delta.content` for display and assemble `delta.tool_calls` by `index`, executing only after the stream ends.

Set `max_tokens` explicitly (for example 8192-16384 per file or batch) to bound cost and latency. The 1M context is capacity, not a budget; output is billed per token, and v4-pro output is $1.98/$3.96 per 1M tokens off-peak/peak.

Keep the system prompt and early history stable to maximize automatic prompt-cache hits, and log `usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens`/`prompt_cache_miss_tokens`. Because the API is stateless, compact older history client-side; DeepSeek's own Claude Code recipe treats 786432 tokens as the auto-compact window.

Retry only 429/500/503 with exponential backoff and jitter; 429 means account concurrency saturation (500 for v4-pro), not a per-minute quota. Fail fast on 400/401/402/422, surface 402 (insufficient balance) in the GUI, and parse error bodies as text-or-JSON because errors may be plain text.

Avoid `tool_choice:"required"` or named-tool forcing while thinking is enabled (HTTP 400); use `auto`, or disable thinking first. Batch small files into one `write_files` tool call accepting a JSON object of path-to-content to reduce round trips.

### 模块职责与边界

- `LLMClient` 与工具分发是两个明确接缝：mock 只需实现 `complete()` 返回脚本化 `tool_calls`；测试不触网。
- `preprocessor.py` 负责 Markdown 的确定性结构化；LLM 永远看不到原始 Markdown，只看 `spec_digest.py` 产出的摘要。完整 `spec.json` 落盘到运行目录，供人工排查。
- 运行产物放在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\CodeAgent\runs\<UTC时间戳>\`（spec.json、plan.json、transcript.jsonl、report.json），生成目录只保留用户项目，避免污染交付物。
- `transcript.jsonl` 逐条记录 assistant 原文、tool_call、tool_result、usage；写盘前统一调用 `redact_secrets()`，把 `sk-...` 与 Authorization 头替换为 `***`。

### 数据流（一次运行）
1. GUI 校验：两个 md 路径存在、输出目录为空或用户勾选允许覆盖、API Key 非空（mock 模式除外）、模型名非空。
2. `preprocessor.preprocess(doc, views)` → `spec.json`；统计与 `analysis.gaps`（本例中会有 `sql/question_ddl.sql` 不在交付物清单、`AdminComponent` 未介绍两条 gap）。
3. `spec_digest.build(spec)` → 摘要：title、architectural_style、deployment_topology、components 及 component_details 的 technology_options/接口/数据模型、traceability 全表、deliverables 全表、review_checklist、analysis.gaps、明确「deliverables 清单为交付权威」。摘要硬上限 12,000 字符，超限按优先级截断。
4. `planner.plan(digest)`：1 次 LLM 调用（JSON mode），产出 plan JSON；本地校验（路径、必填文件、批次、deliverables 覆盖）；失败重试 1 次；仍失败则用 `fallback_plan()`（由 deliverables + components 确定性生成）并标注 `planned_by=fallback`。
5. 生成循环：`run_tool_loop(phase="generate")`，模型通过 7 个工具把文件写到 workspace；每完成一个文件发 `FileWritten`，GUI 进度条前进。
6. `checks.run_all(plan, workspace)`：计划文件齐全、非空、UTF-8 可解码；`.py` 用内置 `compile()` 检查语法（不依赖系统 Python，冻结 exe 也可用）；`.json` 用 `json.loads`；`.yaml/.yml` 用 PyYAML `safe_load`；`.js` 在检测到 Node 时用 `node --check`；README/tests/依赖清单存在；禁止路径越界；可选占位符扫描。
7. 失败则 `repair`：最多 2 轮，每轮 1 个修复 prompt + 最多 6 步工具循环；每轮后重跑检查。失败签名连续两轮相同则提前熔断。
8. 最终状态：`completed` / `completed_with_warnings` / `repair_exhausted` / `max_steps` / `stalled` / `cancelled` / `api_error` / `plan_failed`；写 `report.json`（模型、参数、token/缓存命中、耗时、文件清单、检查结果、未解决项）。
9. GUI 弹结果摘要，给出「打开输出目录 / 打开运行日志」按钮。
synth.agentLoopDesign:
## 状态机与阶段

```
Preflight → Preprocess → Plan → GenerateLoop → CheckGate → RepairLoop(≤2) → CheckGate → Finalize
```

### 阶段 0：Preflight
- `GET {base_url}/models`（10s connect / 60s read）验证 Key；401 → 立即 AuthError；402 → BalanceError；200 但列表无 `deepseek-v4-pro` → 警告但允许继续（兼容网关别名）。
- 输出目录必须是新目录或空目录；非空且未勾选「允许覆盖」→ 拒绝启动。允许覆盖时先把将被覆盖的文件复制到 `<workspace>/.codeagent_backup/<timestamp>/`。
- 建立 `ToolContext`：`workspace=Path(out).resolve()`、`read_files=set()`、`written_files=dict[path→sha256]`、`cancel=threading.Event()`。

### 阶段 1：Plan（1–2 次模型调用）
1. system = `PLAN_SYSTEM_PROMPT`（含 schema 与规则）；user = digest + 环境信息。
2. 请求 `response_format={"type":"json_object"}`、`thinking={"type":"enabled"}`、`reasoning_effort="high"`、`max_tokens=16384`、`stream=false`。
3. `json.loads` 严格解析（拒绝 markdown 围栏）；空/空白 content 或解析失败 → 重试 1 次（缩短摘要、强调 "Return only a json object"）。
4. 校验：1–40 个文件；所有路径为相对路径、无 `..`、无盘符、长度 ≤ 240；路径唯一；每批 ≤ 4 个文件；必须有 README、依赖清单（node→package.json / python→requirements.txt）、tests/ 下至少 1 个文件、spec.deliverables 全覆盖；`est_lines ≤ 400`。
5. 仍失败 → 确定性兜底计划（deliverables + components 映射为文件），状态标 `plan_fallback`，不阻塞生成。

### 阶段 2：GenerateLoop（工具循环，最多 30 步）
每步严格按以下顺序，禁止提前执行工具：

1. `if cancel.is_set(): return CANCELLED`
2. 限额检查：`step > 30` → `MAX_STEPS`；`model_calls > 45` → `MAX_CALLS`；`prompt_tokens_total > 600_000` 或 `completion_tokens_total > 80_000` → `TOKEN_BUDGET`；`elapsed > 20min` → `TIME_BUDGET`。
3. `context.trim(messages)`：保留 system、首条 user（digest+plan）、最近 8 条；把 2 轮以前的 tool 结果内容替换为 `{"elided":true,"path":...,"summary":"..."}`；绝不拆散 assistant(tool_calls) 与其 tool 消息。
4. 构造 payload（静态 system + 全量 messages + 7 个 tools + `tool_choice="auto"`），调用 `client.complete()`（重试见 API 部分）。
5. 检查 `finish_reason`：`length` → 同请求 `max_tokens` 翻倍（上限 32768）并附「上一轮输出被截断，缩小本批文件数」重试一次；仍 length → 该阶段失败。`content_filter`/`insufficient_system_resource`/`aborted` 按错误处理。
6. **原样** append `response.choices[0].message` 字典（不要重建，保留 `reasoning_content`/`tool_calls`/`content` 原字段）。
7. `tool_calls` 为空 → `NO_TOOL_CALLS`，进入 CheckGate（模型纯文本声明完成不算成功）。
8. 对每个 tool_call（最多 8 个/轮，串行执行）：
   - `json.loads(function.arguments)`；失败则返回 `{"ok":false,"error":"invalid JSON arguments","raw":<前500字符>}`，仍生成一条 tool 消息。
   - `registry.dispatch(name,args,ctx)`；任何异常都捕获为 `{"ok":false,"error":...,"hint":...}`，绝不向上抛。
   - 结果 >16 KB 时截断，保留头尾并写 `[truncated N chars; full result in transcript]`。
   - append **恰好一条** `{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":id,"content":result_json}`，顺序与 tool_calls 一致。
   - 发 `ToolStarted`/`ToolFinished` 事件；`FileWritten` 时更新进度。
9. 若 `finish` 被执行 → 记录 `FinishSignal(status, summary, unresolved)` → 退出循环，进入 CheckGate。
10. 停滞检测：连续 3 轮没有任何 `write_file/write_files/edit_file` → 注入一条 user 提醒「已连续 3 轮未写文件，请写剩余文件或调用 finish」；连续 5 轮 → `STALLED`。
11. 重复调用检测：同一 `(name, args_sha256)` 出现 3 次 → 该次直接返回「已执行过，结果相同」；出现 5 次 → `STALLED`。

### 阶段 3：CheckGate（确定性，不调用 LLM）
`checks.run_all()` 产出 `list[CheckFailure]`：
- `manifest_missing`：计划文件不存在；`empty_file`：0 字节。
- `encoding`：非 UTF-8。
- `python_syntax`：`compile(src, path, "exec")`；`json_parse`：`json.loads`；`yaml_parse`：`yaml.safe_load`；`node_syntax`：`node --check`（Node 缺失则 `skipped`，不算失败）。
- `required_baseline`：README.md、依赖清单、tests/、spec.deliverables 全部存在。
- `path_escape`、`placeholder_markers`（TODO/FIXME/NotImplemented，warning 级）。
- 可选 `npm test`（默认关闭，勾选后 120s 超时）与 `python -m pytest -q`（默认关闭）。

所有失败分两类：`fixable`（文件缺失、语法错、JSON/YAML 错、空文件）与 `environment`（Node 不存在、权限拒绝、路径过长、磁盘满）。environment 类不进入自动修复，直接写入报告。

### 阶段 4：RepairLoop（最多 2 轮，每轮最多 6 步）
- 每轮把 fixable 失败合并成**一个** user 消息：`<failures>[{"path","check","message","line"?}]</failures>`，要求「只修这些失败；改前先 read_file；不要重写无关文件；修完调用 run_checks，再 finish」。
- 复用同一个 `run_tool_loop`，但 `max_steps=6`、`temperature=0.0`、无 plan 阶段、不能新增计划外文件（新增只允许测试辅助文件，且计入 manifest 警告）。
- 每轮结束重跑 CheckGate；失败签名（`path+check+message` 归一化哈希）与上一轮相同 → 熔断，`REPAIR_EXHAUSTED`。
- 2 轮后仍有 fixable 失败 → `REPAIR_EXHAUSTED`，报告逐条列出未解决项，不伪造成功。

### 显式停止条件（StopReason）
`COMPLETED`（finish 且检查全过）、`COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS`（无失败仅有 warning）、`NO_TOOL_CALLS`（隐式结束，由检查决定最终状态）、`MAX_STEPS`、`MAX_CALLS`、`TOKEN_BUDGET`、`TIME_BUDGET`、`STALLED`、`CANCELLED`、`API_ERROR`、`PLAN_FAILED`、`REPAIR_EXHAUSTED`。全部写入 `report.json` 并在 GUI 状态栏显示。

### 固定限额（写进 config.py 常量）
- plan 调用 ≤2；生成步数 ≤30；修复 2 轮 × 6 步；总模型调用 ≤45。
- 每轮 tool_calls ≤8；`write_files` 每批 ≤4 文件、总内容 ≤48,000 字符；单文件 ≤256 KB；项目总量 ≤8 MB。
- 工具结果 ≤16 KB；`read_file` 默认 400 行 / ≤48 KB；`run_checks` ≤30 s、输出 ≤8 KB。
- 单次 prompt 估算 ≤120k tokens；全程 prompt ≤600k、completion ≤80k；墙钟 ≤20 分钟。
- 连续 3 轮无写入提醒、5 轮停止；同一调用重复 3 次警告、5 次停止。

### 取消与线程
- `AgentWorker` 为 daemon 线程；`cancel` 在每步开头与每个工具调用之间检查；网络请求设置 `(10, 300)` 超时，取消后最多等待当前请求返回/超时即退出。
- GUI 只通过 `queue.Queue` + `root.after(100, poll)` 更新；worker 绝不触碰 Tk 控件。窗口关闭时置 cancel，`join(timeout=5)`，不阻塞退出。
toolSet: list_files(path: str = ".", recursive: bool = false) -> str — 返回 JSON {"ok":true,"entries":[{"path","type":"file|dir","size"}]}；最多 200 条，超出标注 truncated；拒绝绝对路径与 ..；用于确认目录现状，不读内容。

read_file(path: str, offset: int = 0, limit: int = 400) -> str — 返回带行号文本（格式 f"{i+1:4d} | {line}"），头部注明 total_lines/offset；最多 400 行或 48 KB；文件不存在返回 {"ok":false,"error":"file not found","hint":"use list_files"}；成功读取后把绝对路径加入 ctx.read_files（edit_file 的前置条件）。

write_file(path: str, content: str) -> str — 自动创建父目录；整文件创建/覆盖；返回 JSON {"ok":true,"path","bytes","action":"create|update","sha256"}；content 为空、>256 KB、路径越界、路径长度>240 时返回结构化错误；覆盖前把旧文件快照到 .codeagent_backup/<ts>/；只接受相对路径。
write_files(files: list[{path: str, content: str}]) -> str — 批量写文件，关键的成本控制工具；每批 ≤4 个文件、总字符 ≤48,000；逐个执行与快照；返回 {"ok":true,"written":[{path,bytes,action}],"failed":[{path,error}]}；部分失败不抛异常，由模型下一轮补写。

edit_file(path: str, old_string: str, new_string: str, replace_all: bool = false) -> str — 精确字符串替换；要求文件已在本会话 read_file 过；old_string 必须出现且唯一（replace_all=true 时允许多次）；old_string==new_string 报错；0 次返回 "old_string not found in {path}"，多次返回 "found N matches; set replace_all=true or provide more context"；返回 JSON {ok,path,replacements,bytes}；用于修复阶段，不用于首次生成。

run_checks(kind: str, paths: list[str]) -> str — 类型化确定性检查，不开放任意 shell。kind ∈ {"python_syntax","json_parse","yaml_parse","node_syntax","file_exists","no_placeholders"}；python_syntax 用内置 compile()（冻结 exe 也可用），node_syntax 调 node --check（Node 不存在返回 skipped）；返回 {"ok":bool,"results":[{"path","kind","ok","message","skipped"?}],"summary":{"passed","failed","skipped"}}；输出 ≤8 KB，超时 30 s。

finish(summary: str, status: str, unresolved: list[str] = []) -> str — status ∈ {"complete","partial","blocked"}；summary ≤1000 字符；调用后由 ToolContext 抛出内部 FinishSignal 终止循环；返回 {"ok":true,"status","note":"external checks still run"}。它只是显式完成信号，不能替代 CheckGate。
synth.promptDesign:
## 总体原则
- 原始两份 Markdown **永不**进入 LLM；只发送 `spec_digest`（8–12 KB）。完整 spec 落盘供人查看。
- system prompt 是**静态常量**（字节级稳定，利于 DeepSeek 前缀缓存）；所有动态内容（摘要、计划、manifest、环境）放在首条 user 消息，避免破坏缓存前缀。
- 所有阶段使用原生 `tools`/`tool_calls`，禁止让模型在正文里输出文件内容或用正则从文本里抠工具调用。
- 提示词用英文书写（模型遵循度更稳），GUI 与报告用中文；生成的项目内容语言由 spec 决定（本例为英文）。

## 1. 生成/修复阶段静态 System Prompt（prompts.py 常量，约 1.2k tokens）
按固定顺序：

```
# Role
You are a project-generation agent. You create a complete, runnable project on disk
from a structured specification and an approved plan. You act only through tools.

# Authority
- <project_spec>, <plan> and <manifest> in the first user message are the source of truth.
- If documents conflict, the deliverable list wins; record the assumption in README.md.
- Never invent frameworks, services or dependencies that the spec does not imply.

# Workspace rules
- All paths are relative to the workspace root. Never use absolute paths, drive letters, "..".
- Write only with write_file / write_files / edit_file. Never claim a file exists without writing it.
- write_file creates parent directories automatically.

# File rules
- Write COMPLETE files: no TODO, FIXME, "pass  # implement", "...", or pseudo-code.
- UTF-8, LF or CRLF consistently, no BOM; keep each file <= 400 lines.
- Config/manifest files must be valid: package.json JSON, requirements.txt one dep per line,
  YAML valid, SQL executable, tests runnable.
- Prefer the standard library / framework built-ins; do not add dependencies beyond the plan.

# Tool protocol
- read_file before editing an existing file. edit_file needs an exact, unique old_string.
- Use write_files for batches (max 4 files per call); use write_file for a single large file.
- Use run_checks before finishing; fix what it reports.
- Never repeat an identical failed call; change approach or call finish(blocked).

# Output protocol
- Each turn: either one or more tool calls, or finish(...). Do not emit file contents as prose.
- Keep any assistant text to one short status line.
- Call finish exactly once when the manifest is complete, or when genuinely blocked.

# Completion checklist
- Every planned file written and non-empty; baseline README/dependency manifest/tests present.
- All spec deliverables present; run_checks reports no failures.
```

## 2. 首条 User 消息模板（每阶段重新生成，带 XML 标签便于定位）
```
<project_spec>
{ "title": "...", "architecture_style": "...", "deployment": "...",
  "components": [{"name","responsibilities","technology_options","external_apis",
                  "internal_contracts","data_model"}],
  "traceability": [{"id","short_text","components","artifacts","rationale"}],
  "deliverables": ["architecture.md","openapi.yaml","internal.proto",
                   "k8s/spacefractions-deployment.yaml","sql/game_ddl.sql",
                   "traceability_matrix.csv"],
  "review_checklist": [...], "gaps": [...],
  "authority_note": "deliverables list is authoritative; gaps are advisory" }
</project_spec>
<plan>
{ ...本项目 plan JSON，见下... }
</plan>
<manifest>
{"written":["package.json","src/server.js"],"pending":["src/game.js","tests/game.test.js"],
 "progress":"2/12"}
</manifest>
<environment>
{"workspace":"<output dir>","os":"Windows 11","node":"24.14.0","python":"3.12.14",
 "note":"paths in tool calls are relative to workspace"}
</environment>
<task>
Write the pending files in plan batch order. After all files exist, call run_checks for
python_syntax/json_parse/yaml_parse/node_syntax on all generated files, fix failures,
then call finish. Do not rewrite files already written unless a check fails.
</task>
```

## 3. Plan 阶段提示词
- system：`You are a software project planner. Output json only.` + 规则（只能用 spec 中的技术栈；文件 1–40 个；每批 ≤4；每文件 ≤400 行；必须覆盖 deliverables、README、依赖清单、tests）。
- user：digest + `Plan the file manifest. Return a json object with this exact shape:` + schema + 一个最小示例。
- 必须出现单词 "json" 与示例（DeepSeek JSON mode 要求），并设 `response_format={"type":"json_object"}`。
- Plan schema（校验器按此实现）：
```json
{
  "project_name": "space-fractions",
  "summary": "one paragraph",
  "stack": {"language":"javascript","runtime":"node","framework":"express","database":"postgresql"},
  "entrypoints": ["src/server.js"],
  "files": [
    {"path":"package.json","purpose":"deps and scripts","kind":"config",
     "est_lines":40,"batch":1,"depends_on":[]}
  ],
  "batches": [{"id":1,"files":["package.json","README.md"],"rationale":"bootstrap"}],
  "acceptance_checks": [
    {"name":"deliverables exist","kind":"file_exists",
     "targets":["openapi.yaml","internal.proto","sql/game_ddl.sql"]},
    {"name":"package.json valid","kind":"json_parse","targets":["package.json"]}
  ],
  "assumptions": [],
  "risks": []
}
```
- 解析失败重试一次；禁止接受 markdown 围栏；仍失败走确定性 fallback plan。

## 4. 修复阶段提示词
- system 复用静态生成 prompt，追加一段（作为 system 的第二段或首条 user 前缀）：
```
# Repair mode
- Only fix the failures listed in <failures>. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
- read_file before edit_file. Keep the public interface unchanged unless the failure requires it.
- After fixes, call run_checks for the affected files, then finish with status partial if
  any environment-level failure remains.
```
- user：`<failures>[{"path","check","message","line"?}]</failures>` + `<manifest>` + 当前计划摘要；要求一次只处理一个根因，最多 6 步。

## 5. 上下文与输出约束
- 每阶段输出格式：Plan = 纯 JSON 对象；Generate/Repair = 原生 tool_calls，最后必须 `finish`；GUI 事件 = 结构化 `AgentEvent`，不解析模型散文。
- `context.trim()` 只做确定性省略（旧工具结果替换为摘要，保留首条 user 与最近 8 条），不做额外 LLM 摘要调用，省 token、省延迟。
- 工具结果一律 JSON 字符串；`read_file` 例外（带行号文本，便于精确 edit）。
- 失败信息回灌给模型时只保留「路径 + 检查类型 + 首 300 字符错误 + 行号」，避免 traceback 淹没上下文。
synth.apiIntegration:
## 端点与认证
- Base URL 默认 `https://api.deepseek.com`；请求 `POST {base}/chat/completions`。归一化：若 base 已以 `/chat/completions` 结尾则不再拼接；否则 `rstrip('/') + '/chat/completions'`。
- Header：`Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`、`Content-Type: application/json`、`Accept: application/json`。使用 `requests.Session` 复用连接。
- 模型固定默认 `deepseek-v4-pro`（官方文档确认的枚举为 `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro`；不要再默认 `deepseek-chat`）。GUI 可改，但默认值必须是 `deepseek-v4-pro`。
- 「测试连接」按钮：`GET {base}/models`，10s/60s 超时；200 时解析 `data[].id`，若不含 `deepseek-v4-pro` 仅警告（兼容网关别名）；401 直接提示 Key 无效。

## 分阶段请求参数（opinionated）
| 阶段 | thinking | reasoning_effort | temperature | top_p | max_tokens | response_format | tools | stream |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plan | `{"type":"enabled"}` | `"high"` | 省略（thinking 下无效） | 省略 | 16384 | `{"type":"json_object"}` | 无 | false |
| Generate | `{"type":"disabled"}` | 不传 | 0.2 | 1.0 | 16384 | 不传 | 7 个 | false |
| Repair | `{"type":"disabled"}` | 不传 | 0.0 | 1.0 | 16384 | 不传 | 7 个 | false |

关键理由：DeepSeek V4 默认开启 thinking（high），此时 temperature 无效，且带 tools 时必须回传历史 `reasoning_content`，否则 400。生成/修复阶段显式 `thinking disabled`，既让 temperature 生效、输出更确定，也规避 `reasoning_content` 回传坑；plan 阶段无 tools，单次调用，用 thinking 提升规划质量。

消息序列化（OpenAI 兼容）：
- assistant：`{"role":"assistant","content": <可空>,"tool_calls":[{"id","type":"function","function":{"name","arguments":"<JSON 字符串>"}}]}`；**原样保存并回传服务端返回的 message 字典**，不要字段重建。
- tool：`{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":<id>,"content":"<string>"}`；每个 tool_call 恰好一条，顺序一致，即使参数解析失败/工具不存在/被拒绝也要回。
- tools 定义：`{"type":"function","function":{"name","description","parameters":<JSON Schema>}}`；schema 每个 object 都带 `properties` 与 `additionalProperties:false`，required 显式列出；不使用 beta `strict`。
- `tool_choice="auto"`。禁止 `"required"` 或具名工具（thinking 模式下会 400）。

## JSON mode 要点
- Plan 阶段 prompt 必须包含单词 "json" 和一个示例；否则可能返回非 JSON。
- 失败表现：`content` 全是空格且 `finish_reason:"stop"`。处理：重试 1 次（temperature 可降到 0、缩短 digest、强调 "Return only a json object"）；仍失败走 fallback plan。
- 校验使用严格 `json.loads`；拒绝 ```json 围栏，先在代码里剥离围栏再解析（宽容解析、严格校验）。

## 错误码、重试与提示
| 状态 | 含义 | 策略 |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | 请求体/schema/消息配对错误 | 不重试；检查孤立 tool 消息、tool_choice、参数；显示 body 前 500 字符 + 修复建议 |
| 401 | 认证失败 | 不重试；GUI 弹「API Key 无效/已过期」 |
| 402 | 余额不足 | 不重试；GUI 显示充值提示 |
| 422 | 参数非法 | 不重试；检查 thinking/tool_choice/stream_options 组合 |
| 429 | 并发/限流（v4-pro 账户并发 500） | 重试；优先 `Retry-After`，否则指数退避 |
| 500 | 服务端错误 | 重试 |
| 503 | 过载 | 重试 |
| 连接超时/重置 | 网络 | 重试 2 次；已产生部分流则不重放工具 |
| 10 分钟未开始推理 | 服务端断连 | 视为可重试一次 |

重试实现：`MAX_ATTEMPTS=4`，延迟 `min(1 * 2**(attempt-1), 20)s + random(0,0.5)s`，总等待 ≤40s；只对 429/5xx/网络错误重试。响应体可能不是 JSON（已观测 401 纯文本 `Authentication Fails (governor)`），解析必须 text-or-JSON，并记录 `x-ds-trace-id`。超时 `(connect=10, read=300)`；非流式请求服务端可能用空行 keep-alive。

`finish_reason` 处理：
- `length`：输出截断。同请求 `max_tokens` 翻倍（≤32768）并附「split into smaller batch」重试一次；仍截断 → 阶段失败（不得把半截文件当成功）。
- `content_filter`：阶段失败并报告。
- `insufficient_system_resource` / `aborted`：重试一次。
- `tool_calls`：正常继续。
- `stop` 且无 tool_calls：隐式结束，进入 CheckGate。

## usage、成本与缓存
- 每次响应读取 `usage.prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/total_tokens`、
  `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`/`prompt_cache_miss_tokens`、`prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`、
  `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`；累计显示在 GUI 状态栏与 report.json。
- 1M 上下文是容量不是预算；本项目主动限制单次 prompt ≤120k、全程 prompt ≤600k、completion ≤80k。
- 稳定 system 前缀 + 稳定工具顺序 + 动态内容只放 user 消息，最大化前缀缓存命中；不把时间戳、随机 ID 写进 system。

## 流式建议
默认**非流式**：工具循环需要完整 message 才能安全执行，非流式实现简单、错误边界清晰。GUI 的「进度」来自工具事件（每写一个文件前进一格），不需要 token 级流。
若后续要加流式：`stream=true, stream_options={"include_usage":true}`；按空行切 SSE，忽略 `[DONE]`，按 `tool_calls[].index` 聚合 `id/name/arguments`，流结束后再执行工具；遇到 HTML 响应提示「检查 endpoint URL」。本期不实现，避免复杂度。

## Key 与会话安全
- Key 只从 GUI 密码框（`show="*"`）或环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 读取，仅存内存；不写 config.json、不写 transcript、不写 exe 资源。
- 所有异常与日志经 `redact_secrets()`；报告里显示 `sk-****` 尾 4 位。
- 用户已在对话中暴露过该 Key，交付前建议在 DeepSeek 控制台**轮换/重置**，旧 Key 作废。
- Mock 模式：`CODEAGENT_MOCK=1` 或 GUI「离线演示」勾选，使用 `MockLLMClient` 返回脚本化 plan 与 write_files 调用；可在无 Key、零费用下跑通预处理→规划→生成→检查→修复全链路，并作为回归测试。
riskChecklist: API Key 泄露：Key 已在聊天中明文出现，且极易被写进源码/配置/日志/exe。必须仅内存保存、日志脱敏、禁止硬编码，交付前轮换旧 Key；这是最高优先级。
工具消息配对错误导致 HTTP 400：每个 assistant tool_call 必须有且仅有一条对应 tool 消息（含参数非法、未知工具、拒绝、取消的情况）；历史裁剪时绝不能拆散配对。
thinking 默认开启的连锁坑：v4-pro 默认 thinking=high，导致 temperature 失效；带 tools 时不回传 reasoning_content 会 400，tool_choice=required/具名也 400。生成/修复必须显式 disabled。
输出截断写坏文件：finish_reason=length 时半截 JSON/Python 会被写入磁盘；必须检测 length、重试并缩小批次，绝不当成功。
循环/费用失控：没有硬上限会无限自我调用。必须同时有步数、总调用数、token、墙钟、停滞、重复调用五重刹车。
路径逃逸与任意命令执行：模型可写 `..\..\Windows` 或执行危险命令。必须 resolve 后校验 commonpath、拒绝绝对路径，run_checks 只做类型化检查而非任意 shell。
PyInstaller 打包失败：tkinter/requests/PyYAML 的 hidden imports、certifi CA 路径、onefile 解压目录、`sys.executable` 在冻结后是 exe 而非 Python。syntax 检查必须用内置 compile()，不能依赖系统 Python。
构建环境无可用 Python：本机 `python`/`python3` 指向 Windows Store 存根（退出码 49），`py` 报告无运行时。必须用 uv 的 `python3.12.exe` 创建 venv，并在 venv 内装 requests/PyYAML/pyinstaller。
中文/空格路径：项目位于 `E:\vibe coding作业\CodeAgent`，输出目录也可能含中文。所有 I/O 用 pathlib + UTF-8，subprocess 用参数列表、`encoding='utf-8'`，避免 shell 字符串与本地代码页问题。
GUI 线程违规：worker 直接操作 Tk 控件会随机崩溃。只能 queue + `after()`；窗口关闭要 cancel + join，避免僵尸线程。
Plan JSON 无效/空白：JSON mode 可能返回全空格；必须严格解析、重试 1 次、准备确定性 fallback plan，不能卡死。
上下文被原始 spec 与工具输出撑爆：完整 architecture_input.json 约 45–60 KB，逐轮重发既贵又易溢出。只发 8–12 KB digest；旧工具结果必须省略。
覆盖用户已有文件造成数据丢失：输出目录非空时必须确认，并在覆盖前快照到 .codeagent_backup。
Node/npm 环境差异：本机 Node 24/npm 11 可用，但目标机器未必；node --check 缺失应标记 skipped，不能因此判定项目失败。
检查过严导致无限修复：环境类失败（无 Node、权限、磁盘满）不可修复，必须分类并跳过自动修复；同一失败签名两轮即熔断。
模型幻觉依赖/接口：可能引入 spec 没有的库或伪造 API。prompt 明确「spec 为权威、不得新增依赖」，并在检查中核对 package.json/requirements 与 import 的大致一致性（warning）。
Windows 长路径与非法文件名：生成路径加上输出目录可能超过 260 字符；写入前检查总长度 ≤240，拒绝 `CON/PRN/AUX/NUL` 等保留名。
requests/SSL 在冻结 exe 中证书缺失：显式使用 certifi.where()，打包时确保 certifi 数据被收集；否则所有 HTTPS 调用失败。
GUI 假死：网络调用在主线程会冻结界面；必须 worker 线程 + 超时 + 取消，状态栏显示已耗时。
Mock 与真实 API 行为漂移：mock 永远成功会掩盖 400/429。必须保留真实 API 冒烟测试（test connection + 一次 plan 调用），并记录 trace id。
一文件一次 LLM 调用导致又慢又贵：必须 plan 驱动 + write_files 批量（≤4 个/批）+ 进度条；单文件过大时拆分为更小的实现，而非无限加大 max_tokens。
PyInstaller onefile 被杀软误报/启动慢：使用 windowed、版本信息、稳定构建环境；首次启动 3–8 秒属正常，GUI 显示启动提示；在干净 Windows VM 实测。
acceptanceChecklist: 【GUI 字段】主窗口具备：API Key（掩码、可显示/隐藏、来自环境变量）、Base URL（默认 https://api.deepseek.com）、模型名（默认 deepseek-v4-pro）、架构文档 1 路径+浏览、架构文档 2 路径+浏览、输出目录+浏览、最大步数、修复轮数、temperature、是否允许覆盖、是否离线 Mock、开始/取消/测试连接按钮、进度条、日志窗、token 与耗时状态栏。关闭窗口能安全取消线程。
【输入预处理】不依赖 LLM，两份 Markdown 经 preprocessor 转成结构化 JSON；GUI 在开始前显示摘要统计（章节/表格/代码块/图/需求/交付物/gaps）；无效路径或解析异常会阻止启动并给出可读错误；含中文路径与空格时正常。
【计划阶段】首次模型调用产出符合 schema 的 plan JSON；校验文件数 1–40、路径相对且唯一、批次 ≤4、必含 README/依赖清单/tests、覆盖 spec.deliverables；无效时重试 1 次并最终 fallback，不阻塞。
【Agent 循环】使用原生 tools/tool_calls；顺序严格为「调用模型→原样记录 assistant→逐个执行工具→每个 tool_call 回一条 tool 消息→再调用」；支持一轮多个 tool_call（≤8）；任何工具异常都变成 tool 结果而非崩溃；每次写文件产生 FileWritten 事件并推进进度条。

【停止条件】以下状态均可触发并在 GUI/report 中显示：finish 完成、无 tool_calls 隐式结束、max_steps(30)、max_calls(45)、token 预算(600k/80k)、墙钟(20min)、stalled(连续 5 轮无写入)、cancelled、api_error、plan_failed、repair_exhausted。模型只口头声称完成不会被当作成功。

【生成项目完整性】在全新输出目录生成：目录结构、源码文件、依赖清单（Node 项目 package.json；Python 项目 requirements.txt）、README.md、tests/ 下至少一个测试、必要时 Dockerfile；本作业 spec 的交付物 openapi.yaml、internal.proto、k8s/spacefractions-deployment.yaml、sql/game_ddl.sql、traceability_matrix.csv、architecture.md 均存在且非空。
【确定性检查】CheckGate 验证：计划文件全部存在且非空、UTF-8、.py 语法（内置 compile）、.json 可解析、.yaml 可解析、.js 在 Node 可用时 node --check、README/tests/依赖清单存在、无路径逃逸；检查结果逐条写入 report.json；Node 缺失只标 skipped。
【有限自动修复】语法/JSON/YAML/缺失文件等可修复失败进入修复，最多 2 轮、每轮 ≤6 步；环境类失败（Node 缺失、权限、磁盘）不修复直接报告；同一失败签名连续两轮 → 熔断；修复后重跑检查，最终状态如实标注 repair_exhausted 与未解决项。

【DeepSeek 集成】POST https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions，Bearer 认证，模型 deepseek-v4-pro；plan 用 JSON mode + thinking high；生成/修复 thinking disabled + temperature 0.2/0.0；tools schema 严格、tool_choice=auto；正确回传 assistant 原始 message 与每个 tool_call_id；测试连接走 GET /models。
【错误处理】400/401/402/422 不重试并给出针对性提示；429/500/503/超时按 4 次指数退避+抖动重试，尊重 Retry-After；纯文本错误体也能解析；trace id 入日志；finish_reason=length 触发放大 max_tokens 重试并缩小批次；错误不导致 GUI 崩溃。
【安全】Key 不写入源码/config/日志/transcript/exe；日志显示 `sk-****`；所有写入被限制在 workspace，绝对路径与 .. 被拒绝；run_checks 只接受类型化检查，无任意 shell；覆盖已有文件先备份。
【离线 Mock】设置 CODEAGENT_MOCK=1 或勾选离线演示后，无 Key、无网络可完整跑通「预处理→plan→生成→检查→修复→报告」，生成一个最小示例项目；该路径纳入 pytest 回归。

【PyInstaller 交付】在 uv 创建的 Python 3.12 venv 内用 `python -m PyInstaller packaging/codeagent.spec` 生成单文件 `CodeAgent.exe`（windowed）；在干净 Windows 环境、含中文与空格的输出路径下双击可启动、可测试连接、可生成项目；无控制台窗口，日志写 %LOCALAPPDATA%\CodeAgent\logs。
【代码质量与测试】`python3.12 -m pytest -q` 全部通过；新增 spec_digest、plan 校验、path safety、tools、checks、retry、mock loop 的单元测试；preprocessor 现有测试保持通过；关键限额是具名常量，便于调整。
【可观测与报告】每次运行生成 report.json 与 transcript.jsonl：模型、参数、起止时间、每阶段耗时、prompt/completion/cache token、工具调用次数、写入文件清单、检查明细、最终 StopReason、未解决项；GUI 可一键打开输出目录与日志目录。
【真实冒烟】用用户提供的 Key 与 deepseek-v4-pro 实际运行一次：测试连接成功、plan 返回合法 JSON、至少生成 5 个文件、检查通过或仅剩环境类警告；记录 trace id 与 token 消耗；确认 Key 未出现在任何日志文件中，随后建议轮换该 Key。
